description.value:
As an attack begins to strike you, your form flickers into a holographic pattern and vanishes, granting you a +5 bonus to AC against that attack. As part of the same reaction, you may then teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 feet and make one weapon attack against the attacker with advantage.

Overcharge Tech. Casting with a slot of 4th level or higher extends the teleport range by 10 feet for each slot level beyond 3rd.
